text: Yes, the 2022 loss of ~0.6 hectares was corroborated by the independent JRC 2020 reference. The JRC data confirmed the area was fully forested in 2020 (100% agreement), meeting the rule requiring ≥50% overlap with the event area. The loss exceeded the 0.5-hectare minimum threshold, though 0.2 hectares was in small patches excluded from the count. The MGAP map classified the affected area as native forest, further supporting the finding. All three datasets (Hansen, JRC, MGAP) were available and spatially valid for this analysis.
